query:
SELECT CAST(receipt_id AS TEXT) AS "receipt_id?: String",
               CAST(recorded_bear_id AS TEXT) AS "recorded_bear_id!: String",
               CAST(actor_user_id AS TEXT) AS "actor_user_id!: String",
               CAST(previous_user_id AS TEXT) AS "previous_user_id!: String",
               CAST(entity_id AS TEXT) AS "entity_id!: String",
               CAST(destination_user_id AS TEXT) AS "destination_user_id?: String",
               CAST(displaced_entity_id AS TEXT) AS "displaced_entity_id?: String",
               CAST(prior_generation AS TEXT) AS "prior_generation!: String",
               CAST(resulting_generation AS TEXT) AS "resulting_generation!: String",
               CAST(recorded_at AS TEXT) AS "recorded_at!: String"
        FROM user_identity_receipts WHERE bear_id = ?
        ORDER BY (recorded_bear_id = ?) DESC, recorded_at DESC, receipt_id DESC LIMIT ?
